name: National Museum of History
nameVi: Bảo tàng Lịch sử Quốc gia
summary: One ticket covers 1 Trang Tien and 216 Tran Quang Khai. An adult pays 40,000 VND. The hours are 8:00 to 12:00 and 13:30 to 17:00. The closed day is the conflict: the first Monday of the month on one museum page, and every Monday on two others. Read both before you go.
getThere: 1 Trang Tien, south of the lake
heroCaption: The National Museum of History at Trang Tien

notice.title: The closed day is not one figure
notice.body: baotanglichsuquocgia.vn says the museum closes on the first Monday of the month. vnmh.com.vn and baotanglichsu.vn say it closes every Monday. Both stay.

body: The ticket covers two addresses. 1 Trang Tien holds the displays from prehistory to 1945. 216 Tran Quang Khai holds the displays from the mid-19th century to the present. The building at Trang Tien is the yellow facade south of Hoan Kiem.

An adult pays 40,000 VND, a college student 20,000 VND, a school pupil 10,000 VND, and a child under 6 is free. A camera is 30,000 VND and a video camera is 400,000 VND. Hours are 8:00 to 12:00 and 13:30 to 17:00. Tet hours are a separate announcement. The closed day depends on which museum page you read, and both versions are printed here.

figures.caption: The long yellow facade and its tiled roof
figures.alt: The yellow facade of the National Museum of History in Hanoi

gettingThere: 1 Trang Tien is south of Hoan Kiem, near the Opera House. 216 Tran Quang Khai is the second building on the same ticket. The walk from the lake is check on arrival for the minutes.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: Walk south to 1 Trang Tien. The minutes are check on arrival.

closed: First Monday of the month, on baotanglichsuquocgia.vn. Every Monday, on vnmh.com.vn and baotanglichsu.vn. Both stay. Tet hours are a separate announcement.
admissionNote: Adult 40,000 VND. College student 20,000 VND. School pupil 10,000 VND. Under 6 free. The ticket covers 1 Trang Tien and 216 Tran Quang Khai. Camera 30,000 VND. Video 400,000 VND.
